observations.answer: None of the 38 wave-A context entries carries maxCells or maxChars. The 13 entries in these four namespaces that do carry one belong to pre-existing keys this wave never touched (ui.chat.header.conversation_name 24, archived 16, actions 28, copy_id 24, move_device 32, transcript_display 28, delete 28, close_run_details 20, open_run_details 20, new_chat 16, new_chat_with 32, ui.chat.session_status.choose_model 18, last_reading 16), so no audited value can overrun a declared budget. The two amended values measure 24 cells (cancel_rename) and 18 cells (answer_label) by the ur guide's ~1 cell per Arabic-script character rule, against English 13 and 14. Both are an accessible name / tooltip, not a fixed-width caption: cancel_rename is the header rename control's aria-label AND its native title tooltip (chat-header.tsx), answer_label is screen-reader-only (answerActionsLabel in message-actions.ts), so neither sits in a layout that can clip it. No overflow risk claimed or observed, and no rendered-frame measurement is offered - this is a catalogue audit.

observations.topic: RTL / bidi of the two amended values
observations.answer: Both are pure Urdu: no Latin/digit island, no manual bidi control (ur-activation's hygiene test scans the real bundled catalogue and finds none, and the audit's own scan counts zero U+200E/U+200F/U+2066-U+2069/U+061C). GNU fribidi 1.0.16 at base direction RTL pictures them with the phrase head on the right ('حتمی جواب کے اعمال' -> 'ﻝﺎﻤﻋﺍ ﮯﮐ ﺏﺍﻮﺟ ﯽﻤﺘﺣ'), and reversing the visual run after NFKC restores the logical string exactly for both - the same property holds for all 20 pure-RTL wave-A values. No arrow, mirrored-wrong glyph or bidi hazard arises in either string; the wave's placeholder strings with Latin substitutions keep their round-1 behaviour and are not re-scored.
